# Tiny Bee

> A group meetup planner. Each member tells a private planning agent where they're starting from and how far
> they'll drive; Tiny Bee finds the fairest towns, builds a shortlist and runs a ranked-choice vote.

Members' own AI agents can take part through an MCP server at https://tiny-bee.billfugina.com/api/mcp
(remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; no key or client ID needed).

## Docs

- [Plan with your own AI agent](https://tiny-bee.billfugina.com/agents): how to connect Claude, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client, and what the agent can do

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BillFugina/tiny-bee)
